where: Back to the shop where you bought them
note: Return PET drink bottles to the point of sale.
Sort by colour. Blue and red glass goes into the green glass container. Open Monday to Saturday, 7:00 to 20:00. Not on Sundays, public holidays or at night.
Drinking glasses do not belong in the glass container.
Drink cans and food cans count as small metal. The item must fit through the container opening of 22 x 44 cm.
Tie the paper into bundles. Put it out by 7:00 on collection day, but not earlier than the day before. Collection dates are in the Entsorgungskalender.
Tie the cardboard into bundles. Put it out by 7:00 on collection day, but not earlier than the day before. Collection dates are in the Entsorgungskalender.
Return them to the shop that sells them, or take them to the Sonderabfall-Sammelstelle at Hagenholz. The Sonderabfallmobil also visits each neighbourhood once a year.
The Mobile Recyclinghof is free and visits each area 10 to 12 times a year. A Recyclinghof charges a fee for some items. Kerbside pickup costs a fee: call 044 417 77 77.
Only some collection points take textiles. Clothes must be clean and wearable, in a tear-resistant plastic bag that is tied shut.
Accepted: bread, meat and fish including bones, rice, dairy, eggs, sauces and coffee grounds, without packaging. Not accepted: plastic bags or compostable bags, except bio bags with a grid print.
Light bulbs, energy-saving lamps and LEDs count as special waste. Take them to Hagenholz or to the Sonderabfallmobil.

Plastic waste and beverage cartons go into the RecyBag. Buy the bag in many shops in the city and return the full bag to the shops that take it. The city (ERZ) does not sell the bags, so ask the shop for the price.
Waste with no separate collection goes into the official Züri-Sack.
The free ERZ app lists all collections in the city. For questions, call the ERZ Service Center on 044 417 77 77, Monday to Friday, 7:00 to 17:00.
